allow.description: Per data class, the connections it may also go to: personal-data and payroll only to a connection whose transfer is recorded; restricted never.

defaults.description: The defaults that apply beyond it.
examples: personal-data and payroll only where Singapore processing is evidenced; restricted nowhere; know-how and business-figures to any enabled connection

exclude.description: Per data class, the connections it may not go to although the defaults allow it.

version.description: Its version; 0 before any is approved, when only the defaults apply.
